result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A puts 'Delivery slot, step 3 of 4' in the heading, offers six selectable slots with the window and fee on the same row, and places the primary button under the slots, aligned with them. It also has a back link and an order summary, and it has no site navigation. B's heading is 'Choose a delivery slot', so the step count appears only in the progress bar. B also marks one of the six slots as fully booked, and its primary button sits in the sidebar instead of under the slots. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B puts 'step 3 of 4' in the heading, shows six clean slots across two days, and places a single primary button under the content, aligned with it. It also has a back link. A has no step count in its heading text, a fully booked slot that leaves only five choosable slots, and two buttons (Continue and Back) in the summary card, so the primary button isn't under the slot list.
